# grafana_data_sources (Data Source)

Lists all data sources returned by the Grafana API for the organization, including provisioned data sources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "grafana_data_sources" "available" {}

variable "alerts" {
  type = map(object({
    data_source_name = string
  }))
  default = {}
}

locals {
  data_sources_by_name = {
    for source in data.grafana_data_sources.available.data_sources : source.name => source.uid
  }

  eligible_alerts = {
    for name, alert in var.alerts : name => alert
    if contains(keys(local.data_sources_by_name), alert.data_source_name)
  }
}

output "eligible_alerts" {
  value = local.eligible_alerts
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) The Organization ID. If not set, the default organization is used for basic authentication, or the one that owns your service account for token authentication.

### Read-Only

- `data_sources` (List of Object) The organization's data sources, sorted by UID. Each entry contains the numeric `id`, unique `uid`, `name`, `type`, `url`, and `is_default` flag. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_sources))
- `id` (String) The ID of this data source.

<a id="nestedatt--data_sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_sources`

Read-Only:

- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)

- `uid` (String)
- `url` (String)
